text: App-specific tokens exert less influence over value from other projects and typically fail to support a broader user market, because their limited use curtails user access.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860

isBasedOn.name: Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared

abstract: App-specific tokens generally can exert less influence over the value from other projects. App-specific tokens also typically do not allow for a broader user market as the limited use of the token curtails user access.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: tokens fundamentally restricted for use in a given ecosystem
